recordedOnly.note: distinctComponents STOPPED BEING GATED, 2026-08-31, after the capture was read key by key instead of as a bare number. It counts distinct keys in the render tally, and in a production build those keys are MINIFIED identifiers — 'lj', 'dr', 'K' — because the collector reads `type.displayName || type.name`. Where the minifier hands two components the same short name, that name expands into one key per ancestor path, so a single component can contribute a dozen keys made of other minified names. 69 of the 96 keys in the capture that prompted this are exactly that, and the capture records them in `unminifiedComponentKeys`. The number therefore measures the bundler's name assignment, not the app's component set: a rename or a module-order shift anywhere merges or splits a key and moves it. Measured, not argued: one commit that added a single component to the Live screen (a screen the Inventory-change window does not even render) produced a capture in which 71 of 96 keys had a DIFFERENT string from its parent commit while the count and the structure were unchanged; and develop's own tip measured 94/16814 on CI and 96/17534 on a developer machine from the same source. This is the same non-portability that moved the gate 95 -> 93 and then 93 -> 94 within one day, each time recorded as though it were attributable. The counts are gated as RANGES instead, which is what they could always carry: a real regression here is the grid re-rendering an order of magnitude more, not a component type appearing. A quiet window is still exactly ZERO and is gated at zero, for a structural reason rather than an empirical one: the fixture ticker's ~100 commits per 5s all carry an identical body, so no account:changed is emitted at all. The one-item change (dropping a single gear item from a 221-item inventory) costs ~16800 on CI and ~17500 locally across 8 commits, because the grid re-renders all ~220 cards and their per-card subtrees for a change to one of them — a real, pre-existing property of that grid this instrument makes visible, not something any of these measurements introduced. The ranges hold both environments with margin. If a run lands outside them, that is a genuine finding to investigate rather than a number to widen.
